description: This script is a test suite for verifying various 'git push' configurations and behaviors related to push.default settings. It initializes repositories, sets configurations, runs push commands under different scenarios, and checks outcomes to ensure correct push behavior according to different push.default modes.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit in the local revision matches the remote revision after a push.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Performs a push with specified push.default value and verifies success and correct remote content.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Performs a push with specified push.default value and expects failure, verifying that remote branch remains unchanged.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different workflows (centralized/triangular) for a specified push.default setting.
